blockers.title: PPO model produces SHORT only — LONG path dead
blockers.description: 645/645 closed trades are SHORT. PPO action_probabilities[1] (LONG) is near 0 for all sampled symbols. LONG price discovery, trend following on bull moves, and mean reversion from oversold are all impossible.
blockers.verification_command: redis-cli keys 'v2:prediction:*' | xargs -I{} redis-cli get {} | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print([json.loads(l)["selected_action"] for l in sys.stdin if l.strip()][:20])'
blockers.remediation: Retrain PPO with balanced long/short reward. Validate on minimum 100 LONG trades in paper before any live consideration.

blockers.title: Trailing stop fires at 89.9% loss rate — primary loss driver
blockers.description: 395/645 exits are TIER_2_TRAILING_STOP. WR at TS exit = 10.1%. TS fires when position briefly moves favorably then reverses, suggesting stop distance (~60 bps) is too tight for natural volatility.
blockers.raw_evidence: Computed from v2:paper:closed_trades: ts_count=395, ts_wins=40, ts_losses=355, ts_total_pnl=-135.97
blockers.verification_command: redis-cli get v2:paper:closed_trades | python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); ts=[r for r in rows if r.get('exit_reason')=='TIER_2_TRAILING_STOP']; print(len(ts), sum(1 for r in ts if r.get('winner') is True)/len(ts))"
blockers.remediation: Widen TS from ~60 bps to 100-150 bps. Run 200-trade soak. Consider ATR-based dynamic stop.

blockers.title: Portfolio equity excludes closed trade realized PnL
blockers.description: v2:portfolio:state.realized_pnl_usd=0.0 despite 645 closed trades with net $22.23 realized PnL. Portfolio equity ($10,719.36) = initial + unrealized only. Expected: $10,741.59.
blockers.raw_evidence: redis-cli get v2:portfolio:state | jq '{realized: .realized_pnl_usd, equity: .equity}' => {realized: 0.0, equity: 10719.36}
blockers.verification_command: redis-cli get v2:paper:closed_trades | python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); print(f'closed_realized={sum(float(r.get(chr(34)+chr(114)+'ealized_pnl_usd'+chr(34),0) or 0) for r in rows):.2f}')"
blockers.remediation: Fix paper accounting service (mark_to_market.py or accounting.py) to accumulate realized PnL from closed positions into portfolio equity.

blockers.title: squeeze_evidence_score null on 100% of all trades
blockers.description: squeeze_evidence_score field is None for all 645 closed trades. Squeeze-detected events (high-volume reversals, liquidation cascades) enter the system with zero squeeze awareness.
blockers.verification_command: redis-cli get v2:paper:closed_trades | python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=json.loads(sys.stdin.read()); print(sum(1 for r in rows if r.get('squeeze_evidence_score') is None), len(rows))"
blockers.remediation: Populate squeeze_evidence_score from the prediction publisher (OI, funding, liquidation cascade signals). Filter out trades during high-squeeze regimes.

blockers.title: bid_ask_spread_bps hardcoded at 2.0 bps — not market-observed
blockers.description: microstructure_context.bid_ask_spread_bps=2.0 for 100% of trades. The router's high_spread_bps_threshold=12.0 never triggers. Low-liquidity symbols (NIGHTUSDT, PUMPUSDT) receive 2 bps spread when actual may be 50-200 bps.
blockers.remediation: Wire real-time bid/ask spread from Binance orderbook or 24h ticker to microstructure_context. Apply high_spread_bps_threshold filter.

blockers.title: drawdown_at_entry always zero — adaptive drawdown guard non-functional
blockers.description: All 645 trades have drawdown_at_entry=0.0. Strategy router drawdown_block_bps=250 and drawdown_reduce_bps=125 thresholds are never reached. Risk management under sustained drawdown is untested.
blockers.remediation: Compute current_drawdown_bps from portfolio equity vs high-water mark and pass to strategy router.

blockers.title: 5m and 4h timeframes structurally net-negative across 645 trades
blockers.description: 5m: n=143, WR=27.3%, pnl=-$10.15. 4h: n=138, WR=24.6%, pnl=-$3.65. Both negative across full soak. Combined loss: -$13.80.
blockers.remediation: Disable 5m and 4h paper trading. Run 200-trade soak on 1m/15m/1h only to confirm improvement.

blockers.title: Global WR 30.39% below 35% soft threshold
blockers.description: 645 trades: wins=196, losses=449, WR=30.39%. System has positive edge (PF=1.11) but win rate gate requires 35%. Cannot approve live trading.
blockers.remediation: Must reach 35% WR on 200+ new trades after implementing B07 (5m/4h exclusion) and B02 (wider TS). Win rate gate is mandatory before live approval.

blockers.title: Zero-WR symbols still receiving trades: NIGHTUSDT, TIAUSDT, TRUMPUSDT, PUMPUSDT
blockers.description: NIGHTUSDT: 0/5=0% WR, -$5.64. TIAUSDT: 0/3=0% WR, -$2.85. TRUMPUSDT: 0/3=0% WR, -$2.21. PUMPUSDT: 0/3=0% WR, -$2.53. Combined: -$13.23 with 0 wins.
blockers.remediation: Add circuit breaker: 2 consecutive losses per symbol → 24h paper pause. Add these to exclusion list.

blockers.title: LONG action path untested — zero LONG trades in 645-trade soak
blockers.description: No LONG paper trade has ever been executed. The LONG position creation, management, trailing stop, and exit code paths are completely untested in paper mode.
blockers.remediation: Must produce at least 50 LONG paper trades to validate LONG path before any live approval.
